original_frontmatter.name: threejs-3d-generator
original_frontmatter.description: Generate, texture, rig, animate, stylize, convert, and download 3D assets for Three.js games via the Tripo API. Use for text-to-3D, image-to-3D, game-ready GLB/FBX, characters, creatures, buildings, props, weapons, terrain, auto-rigging, animation retargeting, model texturing, voxel/LEGO stylization, and low-poly conversion. Pair with threejs-image-generator for concept and texture references first.
